schema.signals: array — every demand signal ever observed for this organisation: {date, category, categoryLabel, baseScore, confidence, eventSummary, sourceUrl}
schema.matchedCategories: array of category keys matched across all signals on record
schema.region: string — UAE/US/UK/India/Europe or 'Not specified', best-effort inferred, never guessed
schema.outreachHappened: boolean — Part 8, read from CRM outreachHistory
schema.proposalCreated: boolean — Part 8, read from Sales Director's feed
schema.converted: boolean — Part 8, read from Revenue Hunter's pipeline stage
schema.revenueGenerated: number or null — Part 8, from the same pipeline entry, only once won
